# archestra_schedule_trigger (Resource)

Cron-scheduled trigger that runs an agent on a recurring schedule with a templated message.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run an agent on a cron schedule.
#
# `cron_expression` and `timezone` are validated by the backend; invalid
# values are rejected at apply time. Only internal agents
# (`agent_type = "agent"`) accept triggers — gateways and proxies
# return 400.

resource "archestra_schedule_trigger" "daily_summary" {
  name             = "Daily Engineering Summary"
  agent_id         = archestra_agent.support.id
  message_template = "Summarise the last 24 hours of GitHub issues into a Slack-ready digest."
  cron_expression  = "0 9 * * 1-5"
  timezone         = "America/New_York"
}

# Paused trigger — set `enabled = false` instead of deleting so you
# can resume by flipping it back to true without losing the config.
resource "archestra_schedule_trigger" "incident_drill" {
  name             = "Quarterly Incident Drill"
  agent_id         = archestra_agent.support.id
  message_template = "Simulate an SEV-1 customer outage; walk through the runbook end-to-end."
  cron_expression  = "0 14 1 */3 *"
  timezone         = "UTC"
  enabled          = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the internal agent (`agent_type = "agent"`) the trigger will message.
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression (e.g. `0 9 * * 1-5`). Validated by the backend; rejects invalid expressions at apply.
- `message_template` (String) Message body sent to the agent on each tick.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the trigger.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`). Validated by the backend; rejects non-IANA values at apply.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the trigger fires. Disable to pause without deleting.

### Read-Only

- `actor_user_id` (String) ID of the user the trigger runs as (assigned from the API key's caller at create time).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Schedule trigger identifier.
- `last_executed_at` (String) Last execution timestamp (RFC 3339), or null if never run.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_schedule_trigger.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
